title: Late-Request Surcharge on Northgate Delivery & Installation Old-Appliance Removal
content:
A late-request surcharge is carried by the removal amount on a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment — the removed appliances beyond the included items as priced — as a percentage of it added to it. The percentage follows the calendar days from today to the appointment's currently booked delivery date:

| Calendar days from today to the currently booked delivery date | Surcharge added to the removal amount |
|---|---|
| One day or fewer | 100 percent |
| Two to five days | 50 percent |
| Six or more days | Nothing |

## Boundaries (hypothetical delivery date on the 20th)

| Today | Days to delivery | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| 19th | 1 | 100 percent |
| 18th | 2 | 50 percent |
| 15th | 5 | 50 percent |
| 14th | 6 | Nothing |

**Hypothetical figure.** A removal amount of $30.00 requested 1 day before delivery becomes $60.00; 3 days before, $45.00; 8 days before, $30.00.
